x-e-h1-09.title: Ta yaya za mu rubuta sanarwa biyu masu saɓani a jaridar makaranta?

Hoton sanarwar majalisar ɗalibai: “Biki: Juma’a, ƙarfe 5 na yamma, a babban ɗakin motsa jiki. Tikiti: won 1,000.”

x-e-h1-01.title: Shin yanayi guda ɗaya zai iya tabbatar da cewa abu yana faruwa “koyaushe”?
x-e-h1-01.goal: A cikin rubutu mai hujja, nemo layin da shaidarsa ba ta goyi bayan iƙirarin yadda ya kamata ba, sake rubuta shi da jimlar da ta fi taka-tsantsan, sannan ka yanke hukunci kan ƙarin shaidar da ake bukata.
x-e-h1-01.material:
Wannan wani ɓangare ne na rubutun da aka buga a jaridar makaranta (ana fara lissafin layuka daga 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
x-e-h1-01.thinking.0: Nemo tazarar da ke tsakanin shaida da ƙarshe.
x-e-h1-01.thinking.2: Sake rubuta iƙirari ya dace da shaida.
x-e-h1-01.prereq.0: Karanta gajeren rubutu mai hujja da Turanci a matakin aji na farko na sakandare.
x-e-h1-01.prereq.1: Tunanin yau da kullum cewa “dalili” da “abin da ya faru a lokaci guda bisa sa’a” na iya bambanta.
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.prompt: A cikin wannan rubutu, wane layi ne na farko da ya zana ƙarshe mafi girma fiye da shaidar layi na 2?
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, ka bambance “abin da ya ruwaito” da “abin da ya ƙare da shi”.
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ga kowane layi, rubuta ko yana magana game da mutum ɗaya, wasu mutane, ko kowa, sannan ka kwatanta shi da shaidar layukan baya.
x-e-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne matsalar. Faɗin cewa maki za su “tabbas” yi ƙasa ga “duk ɗalibai” bisa raguwar makin ɗalibi guda ɗaya kawai (layi na 2) ƙarshe ne mafi girma fiye da shaida. Raguwar maki na iya samun wasu dalilai, kamar wahalar jarabawa ko yanayin ɗalibi. Layi na 4 ya ba da dalili dabam da maki (hayaniya, magudi), saboda haka dole ne a yi la’akari da shi dabam daga wannan matsala. “A hana kowa” a layi na 5 ma ya dogara da wannan ƙarshe, amma wurin da matsalar ta fara bayyana shi ne layi na 3.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.prompt: Wane sabon bayani ne zai fi dacewa a tattara domin gwada ko iƙirarin layi na 3 daidai ne?
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunani ko idan aka tattara bayanan kowane zaɓi, za a iya samun irin wannan bayanin ko da layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunani ko samun wasu misalai kaɗan makamantan haka zai kawar da wasu dalilai.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.a: Ra’ayoyin mutane na iya bambanta da ainihin canjin maki.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.c: Wannan yana tattara ƙarin misalai iri ɗaya, amma bai kawar da wasu dalilan da suka sa makin ɗaliban suka ragu ba.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.d: Yadda ake amfani da waya a aji ba ya nuna dangantakarta da maki kai tsaye.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.explain: Idan aka kwatanta ɗaliban da suke da waya da waɗanda ba su da ita a tsawon lokaci ɗaya, za a iya auna ko bayanin “saboda wayoyi” ya fi sauran dalilai dacewa. Tattara ƙarin misalai ko tambayar ra’ayi yana sa iƙirarin ya ji ƙarfi ne kawai.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta layi na 3 ya dace da shaidar layi na 2 (jimlolin Turanci 1-2), sannan ka kuma rubuta ƙarin bayanan da ake bukata domin bincika iƙirarin.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko ka taƙaita yanayin Mina.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi ƙoƙarin haɗa duka “ba ya tabbatar” da “bayanan da ake bukata”.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Jimlar da ka rubuta ba ta yi iƙirari mafi girma fiye da bayanin layi na 2 (ɗalibi guda ɗaya)?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Tare da bayanan da ka ambata, za ka iya kwatanta da “yanayin da ba a da waya”?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Jimlar tana nuna cewa akwai yiwuwar wasu dalilai dabam?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: An ambaci sauran dalilai kai tsaye.

x-e-h1-04.s.s1.reflect: Fassarar ta canza duk lokacin da alamu suka ƙaru? Idan ta canza, ambaci jimla guda da ta jawo hakan.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.prompt: Menene muhimmin dalilin da ya sa “Great.” yake kama da ɓacin rai maimakon ma’ana mai kyau?
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bincika ko kowane dalili yana cikin tattaunawar da gaske.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sake karanta “Great.” kana ɗauka cewa yanayin jinkirin mintuna 40 bai faru ba.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.o.a: Domin kalmomin suna da ma’ana mai kyau, amma ba su dace da yanayin zuwansa a makare ba.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.o.b: Domin “Great” yawanci kalmar sarcasm ce a Turanci.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.r.b: Wannan gama-gari ne cewa kalma guda koyaushe tana da ma’ana iri ɗaya.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.o.c: Domin muryar Mina tana da ƙarfi.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.r.c: Wannan tattaunawar ba ta da bayani game da muryarta. Dalili ne da aka ƙirƙira, ba ɗaya daga alamun da aka bayar ba.
x-e-h1-04.s.s2.explain: Ma’ana ba kalmomi kaɗai suke kayyade ta ba, har da ko kalmomin sun dace da yanayin. Idan kalmomin suna da kyau amma yanayin ba shi da kyau, za ka iya zargin akwai ma’ana a ɓoye.

x-e-h1-05.topic: Abin da ake nufi a ɓoye da salon magana.
x-e-h1-05.title: Shin “I have a test” ƙin gayyata ne ko ba haka ba?
x-e-h1-05.goal: Tsara ƙarin bayanin da ake bukata domin yanke ma’anar da amsa ba ta faɗa kai tsaye ba (ko ƙin gayyata ce), sannan ka rubuta saƙon tambaya ba tare da jawo rashin fahimta ba.
x-e-h1-05.material:
Waɗannan saƙonnin rubutu ne tsakanin Jin da Hana.

Jin: Are you coming to the study group tonight?
Hana: I have a huge test tomorrow.
Jin: So is that a no?
Hana: Haha, I don't know yet.
x-e-h1-05.thinking.0: Ganin cewa ma’anar da ke ɓoye ba ta tabbata a matsayin abu guda kawai
x-e-h1-05.thinking.1: Bambanta bayanin da ake buƙata wajen yanke hukunci da wanda ba a buƙata
x-e-h1-05.thinking.2: Yi tambayar da ba ta zargi mutum
x-e-h1-05.prereq.0: Karanta gajerun saƙonnin Turanci na matakin shekarar farko ta sakandare
x-e-h1-05.prereq.1: Fahimtar yau da kullum cewa wani lokaci amsa ba ta amsa tambaya kai tsaye
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanan da kake buƙatar ƙarin sani kafin ka yanke hukunci ko Hana za ta zo.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin wani yanayi da amsar Hana ke nufin “ba zan iya zuwa ba” da wani da take nufin “zan zo”.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo a zaɓuɓɓukan bayanin da zai bambanta waɗannan yanayi biyun.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.b: Lokacin jarabawar ba shi da alaƙa kai tsaye da ko Hana za ta zo.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.d: Ba a amfani da yawan mutane kai tsaye wajen tantance zaɓin Hana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.explain: Maganar Hana na iya nufin “ba zan iya zuwa ba saboda jarabawar”, ko “zan zo in yi karatu don jarabawar”. Don haka kana buƙatar sanin ko ƙungiyar ta shafi wannan jarabawar ce, da irin halin Hana yayin karatu.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.0: Manufar ƙungiyar ita ce mafi muhimmancin bayani don yanke hukunci. Zai fi kyau kuma a duba halayen karatun Hana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.1: Halayen karatu suna da muhimmanci, amma kana kuma buƙatar duba ko ƙungiyar ta shafi wannan jarabawar ce.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.prompt: A matsayinka na Jin, ka rubuta wa Hana saƙon Turanci (jimla 1–3). Sharuɗɗa: ambaci jarabawa/karatu, haɗa aƙalla tambaya guda da za ta amsa ba tare da matsin lamba ba, sannan ka ba da shawara ko zaɓuɓɓuka game da yin karatu tare.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin hanyoyi biyu da Hana za ta iya zaɓa (ta zo su yi karatu, ko ta yi karatu a gida).
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka gwada tsarin “Do you want to ...?” ko “If you ..., we could ...”.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Saƙon ya bar wa Hana damar zaɓa ba tare da matsa mata ba?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka yi tambaya ta yadda yanayin zai iya canzawa bisa ga amsar Hana?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ya tambayi ko ya bayyana bayanin da ka zaɓa a mataki na 1 da gaske?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ya tambayi ko jarabawar ɗaya ce, ya kuma ƙara wani sharadi.

x-e-h1-07.title: Shin sabon layin kekuna da gaske ya rage haɗurra?
x-e-h1-07.goal: Yayin da ake ƙara shaida ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sake tantance yadda ikirarin yake da gamsarwa, sannan ka bayyana da dalilai wane adadi ne ke warware matsalar.
x-e-h1-07.material: Wannan ikirari ne daga labarin birni: “Sabon layin kekuna ya sa titinmu ya fi aminci.” Karanta alamun a jere.
x-e-h1-07.thinking.0: Sauya hukunci idan sabon bayani ya zo
x-e-h1-07.thinking.2: Kada a yanke hukunci daga shaida guda ɗaya
x-e-h1-07.prereq.0: Karanta gajeren labarin Turanci na matakin shekarar farko ta sakandare
x-e-h1-07.prereq.1: Fahimtar yau da kullum don bambanta “ƙima” da “ƙidaya”
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Duk lokacin da ka karanta alama, tantance irin goyon bayan da take ba ikirarin.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ko sabuwar alama ta ba da wani dalili da zai iya bayyana adadin da ya gabata.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bambanta ko adadin yana nufin “yawan lamura” ko “yawan lamura ga kowane yawan mutane”.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Daga wannan alama kaɗai, yaya ƙarfin goyon bayan ikirarin yake?
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Raguwar haɗurra idan aka kwatanta da watan iri ɗaya na bara yana goyon bayan ikirarin, amma wata ɗaya ne kawai.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.o.a: An tabbatar da shi gaba ɗaya.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Alamomi kaɗan ne sosai don yanke hukunci daga adadin wata ɗaya.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: An ɗan tallafa masa, amma wata ɗaya ne kawai, don haka muna buƙatar ƙarin bincike.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Wannan adadin ba shi da alaƙa da ikirarin.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Raguwar haɗurra bayani ne mai alaƙa da ikirarin.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Duba wannan sabuwar alama, ka sauya hukuncinka game da ikirarin.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Ba za ka iya gane ko haɗurra sun ragu saboda hanya ce ko saboda mutane kaɗan ne suka hau keke lokacin ruwan sama ba.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ikirarin ya raunana. Wataƙila haɗurra sun ragu saboda mutane kaɗan ne suka hau kekuna.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ikirarin bai girgiza ko kaɗan ba.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Idan mutane kaɗan ne suka hau, haɗurra ma na iya raguwa.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yanzu ya tabbata cewa ikirarin ƙarya ne.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ikirarin ya raunana ne kawai; wannan ba shaida ba ce cewa ƙarya ne.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Karanta har zuwa alama ta ƙarshe, sannan ka taƙaita hukuncinka.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Lokacin ya tsawaita, kuma duk da cewa yawan masu hawa ya ƙaru, ƙimar haɗurra ta ragu, don haka an warware raunin farko. Duk da haka, ba za a iya cewa babu wani dalili dabam ba sam.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: An ƙara samun ƙarfi sosai wajen tallafa wa ikirarin.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Har yanzu babu wata shaida ko kaɗan.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: An ƙara kwatantawa da ta yi la’akari da tsawon shekara guda da yawan masu hawa.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: An tabbatar cewa hanyar ce kaɗai dalili.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan bayanan ba za su nuna cewa dalilin shi ne “shi kaɗai” ba.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: A wace alama ne imanin ka ya fi sauyawa? Ka faɗi dalilin a jimla ɗaya.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Me ya sa “haɗurra ga masu hawa 1,000” a mataki na 3 ya fi dacewa wajen warware matsalar mataki na 2?
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ka tuna wane ɓangare na adadin haɗurran ne ya kasance matsala a mataki na 2.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.hint.1: Duba abin da ake raba da shi wajen ƙididdigar “ga masu hawa 1,000”.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.a: Domin yana sa adadin haɗurra ya fi girma a gani, don haka ya fito fili.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.a: Adadi ya yi girma a gani da kwatantawa ta gaskiya abubuwa ne dabam.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.b: Ma’aunin ƙidaya ne ya canza; ba a ƙirga ƙarin haɗurra ba.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.c: Domin za ka iya yin kwatanci na gaskiya ko da yawan masu hawa ya canza.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.explain: Idan ka kwatanta ƙidaya kaɗai, ba za ka iya gane ko haɗurra sun ragu saboda hanya ba lokacin da masu hawa suka ragu. Idan ka mayar da shi haɗurra ga mutane 1,000, za ka iya rage tasirin yawan mutane ka yi kwatanci.

x-e-h1-08.title: Shin majiyoyin biyun da gaske sun saɓa?
x-e-h1-08.goal: Nemo layin da ba daidai ba a taƙaitaccen bayanin majiyoyi biyu, ka gyara shi, sannan ka zaɓi mataki na gaba don warware saɓanin.
x-e-h1-08.material:
Waɗannan majiyoyi biyu ne da taƙaitaccen bayanin ɗalibi (lambobin layukan taƙaitawar sun fara daga 1).

Majiyar A (labaran birni, 3 ga Maris): “An sake buɗe ɗakin karatu na Hanbit ranar 1 ga Maris bayan gyara. Yanzu yana buɗe kwana bakwai a mako, kuma kusan mutane 300 sun ziyarta a ranar farko.”
Majiyar B (shafin ɗakin karatu, 5 ga Maris): “Mun sake buɗe ranar 2 ga Maris. Muna buɗe kwana shida a mako, Litinin a rufe. Fiye da baƙi 300 sun zo a ranar farko!”
x-e-h1-08.thinking.0: Bambanta ainihin saɓani da wanda yake kamar saɓani kawai
x-e-h1-08.thinking.1: Nemo kuma gyara kurakurai a taƙaitaccen bayani
x-e-h1-08.prereq.0: Karanta gajerun labaran Turanci da rubutun shafukan yanar gizo na matakin shekarar farko ta sakandare
x-e-h1-08.prereq.1: Fahimtar yawan lambobi na yau da kullum don tantance ko “kusan 300” da “fiye da 300” za su iya dacewa
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya marar daidai a taƙaitaccen bayanin ɗalibin. (Ko da layuka biyu ko fiye ba daidai ba ne, guda ɗaya kawai za ka zaɓa.)
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, rubuta lambobi ko ranakun majiyoyin biyu gefe da gefe.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko lambobin biyun za su iya zama gaskiya lokaci guda.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.explain: Layuka na 3 da 5 su ne matsalar. “Kusan 300” da “fiye da 300” na iya zama gaskiya duka, saboda haka yawan baƙi ba saɓani ba ne (layi na 3). Layi na 5 ya ce wata majiya ta yi kuskure, amma daga wannan rubutu kaɗai ba za ka iya gane wace ce ba. Saɓanin da ke layuka na 2 da 4 na gaske ne.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.prompt: Ka ɗauka cewa layin taƙaitawar da ya kwatanta yawan baƙi a majiyoyin biyu ba daidai ba ne, sannan ka gyara shi da jimlolin Turanci ɗaya ko biyu. Ka bayyana dangantakar da ke tsakanin adadin baƙin majiyoyin biyu.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kwafi daidai yadda kowace majiya ta bayyana yawan baƙi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta zangon lambobin da “kusan” da “fiye da” suke nufi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ya bayyana cewa “kusan 300” da “fiye da 300” za su iya zama gaskiya lokaci guda?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta sunayen majiyoyin biyu (Majiyar A/B) ko kalmominsu daidai yadda suke?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ya yi amfani da “sun yi daidai” don nuna cewa bayanan za su iya zama tare.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.modelNote.2: Ya nuna da takamaiman lamba (310) cewa duka biyun na iya zama gaskiya.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.prompt: Wane mataki na gaba ne ya fi dacewa don gano ko ranar buɗewa 1 ko 2 ga Maris ce?
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi tunani kan irin bayanin da majiyoyin biyun za su iya dogara da shi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin majiya ta uku da za ka iya dubawa kafin ka yarda da ɗaya daga cikin ɓangarorin.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.a: An rubuta Majiyar B a rana ta gaba, saboda haka a bi B ba tare da sake dubawa ba.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.r.a: Rubuta a rana ta gaba ba ya tabbatar da cewa ranar da aka bayar daidai ce. Ana buƙatar shaida da ta binciki ranar kai tsaye.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.b: Nemo sannan ka duba tarihin ranar da aka rubuta lokacin buɗewa (kamar sanarwa).
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.c: Bi rubutun da ya fi yawan masu karatu.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.r.c: Yawan mutanen da suka karanta ba ya tabbatar da daidaito.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.explain: Don gano dalilin bambancin ranakun, kana buƙatar shaida kai tsaye kamar tarihin da aka rubuta a ranar. Lokacin rubutawa ko yawan masu karatu kaɗai ba zai nuna wane ɓangare ne daidai ba.

x-e-h1-10.title: Ƙirƙirar tattaunawa ta ƙin gayyata tare da kiyaye dangantaka
x-e-h1-10.topic: Rubuta amsa ko tattaunawa da ta cika sharuɗɗan
x-e-h1-10.goal: Ka rubuta gajeriyar tattaunawar Turanci da kanka wadda ta cika duk sharuɗɗan (ƙin yarda a sarari, dalili, madadin, da fahimtar ɗayan).
x-e-h1-10.material: Aboki A ya gayyaci B su je shagalin waƙa tare da ƙarfe 7 na yamma ranar Asabar. B yana da taron iyali a wannan maraicen, ba zai iya zuwa ba.
x-e-h1-10.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri tattaunawa da ta cika sharuɗɗan
x-e-h1-10.prereq.0: Karanta da rubuta gajeriyar tattaunawar Turanci ta matakin shekarar farko ta sakandare
x-e-h1-10.prereq.1: Furuci na asali da ake amfani da su idan ba za ka iya amincewa da gayyata ba
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa B ya ƙi?
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta tasirin amsoshin ga yadda A zai ji.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.a: A bayyane take, amma salon yana raina gayyatar ɗayan.

x-e-h1-10.s.s1.explain: Idan aka bayyana ƙin yarda (ba zan iya ba) tare da dalili da wata dama (wata rana), ɗayan ba zai fahimci kuskure ba kuma ba zai ji zafi sosai ba. Amsa marar fayyace tana sa ɗayan jira, amsa mai kaushi kuma tana wahalar da dangantaka.

Ƙirƙiri zance tsakanin A da B da Turanci. Fara kowane layi da A: ko B:, sannan ka rubuta aƙalla layuka 4.

Sharadi 3) B ya ba da shawarar wata rana ko wata hanya.
Sharadi 4) A ya nuna fahimta.

x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta jerin amsar farko ta B: fara da 'godiya' sannan ka yi amfani da can't.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ƙin yarda na B a bayyane yake ko yana da ruɗani kamar 'zan yi ƙoƙarin zuwa'?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Madadin shawara ce da za a iya aiwatarwa da gaske (akwai rana ko hanya)?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Amsar A tana biyo bayan haka a zahiri?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: An cika sharudda iri ɗaya ko da an canja yanayin.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.2: An cika sharudda iri ɗaya da furuci daban-daban.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ko A zai iya gane 'ko B zai iya zuwa ko a'a' bayan jin kowace amsa.
